title: An Adaptive Decentralized Quasi-Newton Method with Stepsizes Independent of the Local-Update Budget
summary: This paper proposes a novel Adaptive Decentralized Quasi-Newton (AdaDQN) method for solving smooth nonconvex optimization problems over undirected networks. While standard decentralized algorithms with multiple fixed local updates typically admit a convergence stepsize inversely proportional to the number of local updates, we show that this scaling is worst-case tight for the typical unscaled fixed-local-update scheme.
